name: 6 nimmt! Baron Oxx
summary: A simultaneous card-placement game where playing the sixth card in a row forces you to take bull-head penalty points.
rules_text: Deal 10 number cards to each player and lay 4 cards as row starters. Each turn all players choose one hand card face-down and reveal together. Sort the revealed cards by number. In that order, each card must be placed on the row whose last card is the closest lower value. If your card is lower than all row ends, you must take an entire row of your choice, scoring its bull heads, and your card starts that row. If your placement would be the sixth card in a row, you take the first five cards as penalty points and your card becomes the new start of that row. After 10 turns the round ends, players tally bulls taken. Shuffle and play multiple rounds until a score limit is reached; lowest total wins.
rating_reason: 6 nimmt! is simultaneous card play with hidden hands
